- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:Line 74 (`TRUSTED_AUTHOR_ASSOCIATIONS = frozenset({"OWNER", "MEMBER", "COLLABORATOR"})`) plus the runtime check at lines ~358-360 (the `if args.issue_author_association.strip().upper() not in TRUSTED_AUTHOR_ASSOCIATIONS:` branch inside `main`). | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The generated-advisory trust check rejects every author_association outside `{OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR}`, including `github-actions[bot]` with `author_association = NONE` when the audit uses `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
  WHY: Weekly-audit-created advisories fail the generated-advisory guard with `EXIT_INVALID_GENERATED_ADVISORY = 30`, preventing planning and implementation.
- scripts/security_audit.sh:Line 179 (`echo "- Never report an accepted finding again, neither under its finding_id nor under a new one, for the same location or the same defect at that location."`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The prompt tells the model to suppress accepted findings by location or defect judgment while deterministic suppression requires an exact `waiver_match_key`.
  WHY: A model-suppressed finding never reaches `normalize_finding` or `matching_waiver`, so a new vulnerability at a waived location can be silently omitted.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:Lines 4672-4721 — `ensure_security_pass_state_fields` removes the trailing `.[-100:]` truncation from three arrays that are reposted into the chunked orchestrator state comment every poll tick: | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `security_pass_waived_findings`, `security_pass_advisory_backlog`, and `security_pass_followup_issues` append forever after their truncation was removed.
  WHY: The arrays are serialized into `STATE_FILE` and posted on every poll tick, eventually exceeding the comment-size budget and stalling or failing the project.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:the sorted `changelog.d/` block (entries jump from `changelog.d/4161-smoke-test-telegram-silencing.md` to `changelog.d/4281-security-pass-exhaustion-judge.md`) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The tracked fragment `changelog.d/4173-security-pass-integrity-hardening.md` is absent from the workspace inventory.
  WHY: The next workspace regeneration will re-add the line and conflict-resolution or merge-train tooling will treat the path as untracked until then.
